top.line: Claude built, animated and rendered a 26-second RiskMandate film in Unreal Engine 5.8 on an unattended MacBook Air.
top.para: In one session: a failed install fixed, Unreal's experimental MCP plugin connected, a folder-based job runner for rendering, and a brand film about reach, mandate and gap at 2560 by 1440. The films are in the newsroom's new media vault, read key published.

in-short.line: A laptop film studio, the first film, the MCP plugin, a job runner, the media vault, and what is next.
in-short.para: Six points from the session notes.

watch.line: Both versions play in the newsroom's media vault, decrypted in your browser.
watch.para: The vault holds every video the newsroom shows from now on; anyone can read it, nobody can change it.

setup.line: Three blockers on a locked-down Mac: a failed install, a missing Metal toolchain, and sleep.
setup.para: Ownership fixed, the toolchain downloaded as the normal user, sleep off on power.

mcp.line: Unreal 5.8's experimental MCP plugin exposes about fifty toolsets with All Toolsets on.
mcp.para: Epic's Agent Skills, read through MCP, explained the first white-out and shaped the lighting.

runner.line: A job runner in a startup Python file runs any job dropped into an inbox folder, including the render.
runner.para: A tool that reported success without doing the work was worked around by editing the project file directly.

film.line: Six beats in 26 seconds: an agent, 108 blocks of reach, green mandate, a barrier, a seal, the end card.
film.para: Version 2 added bevels, materials, softer light and four samples per frame; 26 minutes to render against 3.5.

problems.line: False success, stale copies, jobs inside jobs, and exposure.

why.line: An agent drives a production pipeline end to end, from a conversation; a series is as easy as one film.
why.para: The next step is to turn the folder into proper tools.

limits.line: One session, one machine, one film; the plugin is experimental; the film is silent.
limits.para: Typed titles, not approved logo files yet.

sources.line: The session notes and the films in the media vault.
